Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Both a physician and a janitor had their bags searched at the airport. A drug-sniffing dog had signalled that officers should look into the bag of the physician and, sure enough, they found quite a bit of cocaine. After the janitor's bag was flagged and searched, though, they were let go as it was apparently just a false alarm. Who was free of drugs?
A. Not known
B. The physician
C. The janitor
